description: This file defines the OrderByList class, which represents a list of ordering criteria for querying entities, including methods to add criteria, validate them, and generate SQL ORDER BY clauses.

classes.name: OrderByList
classes.description: Represents a list of order-by criteria for database queries, capable of adding criteria, validating against entity models, and generating SQL syntax.

methods.name: addOrderBy
methods.description: Adds an order-by item to the list. Can accept strings, collections of strings, EntityConditionValues, or OrderByItem objects.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates each order-by item against the provided entity model.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates an SQL ORDER BY clause string based on the configured order-by items.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Implements the Comparator interface to compare two GenericEntity objects based on the order-by criteria.
